Each category on the x-axis has up to three vertically aligned dots representing each entity’s score, with vertical lines connecting them where applicable. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 10 in increments of 2. Categories include “Taxes and fees,” “Subsidies,” “Trading systems,” “Performance Standards,” “Other NMBI,” “Information,” “Technology Standards,” “International Co-operation,” “Public investment and consumption,” “Targets,” “Climate data,” and “Governance.” No arrows or additional symbols are present beyond the dots and connecting lines.
